shortDescription: According to ChainCatcher, NEAR has approved HSP-029, a proposal to cap its token issuance rate at 1.6% within 24 months. The proposal includes a one-quarter grace period. Token issuance will only be reduced after validators individually upgrade and adopt the new rules.
